webApis.name: Web Storage API
webApis.description: The Web Storage API provides mechanisms by which browsers can store key/value pairs locally within a user's browser, in a much more intuitive fashion than using cookies. It includes two storage mechanisms: localStorage for persistent storage and sessionStorage for session-based storage.
usage: Caching data to reduce server requests

components.name: localStorage
components.description: Stores data with no expiration time until explicitly cleared

components.name: sessionStorage
components.description: Stores data for the duration of the page session

localStorage.description: Storing and retrieving data with localStorage

errorHandling.description: Proper error handling and storage limits

webApis.browserSupport: Supported in all modern browsers (IE 8+, Chrome 4+, Firefox 3.5+, Safari 4+)
limitations: Synchronous API can block main thread
Not available in private/incognito mode in some browsers
Can be cleared by user or browser

webApis.name: Web Speech API
webApis.description: The Web Speech API enables web applications to incorporate speech recognition (speech-to-text) and speech synthesis (text-to-speech) capabilities. It consists of two main interfaces: SpeechRecognition for converting speech to text, and SpeechSynthesis for converting text to speech.
usage: Accessibility features for visually impaired users
Language learning applications with pronunciation feedback

components.name: SpeechRecognition
properties: continuous - whether to return continuous results
interimResults - whether to return interim results

limitations: Limited browser support, especially for speech recognition
Accuracy varies with accents and background noise

webApis.name: Web Fetch API
webApis.description: The Fetch API provides a modern, promise-based interface for making HTTP requests in web browsers. It's designed to be more powerful and flexible than the older XMLHttpRequest, offering a cleaner syntax and better support for modern web development patterns including async/await.
usage: Making HTTP requests to REST APIs
Processing JSON and other data formats

components.name: fetch()
components.description: Main function for making network requests

components.name: Response
components.description: Represents the response to a request

basicGet.description: Basic GET request with error handling

advancedFeatures.description: Advanced fetch features including timeout, retry, and interceptors

webApis.browserSupport: Excellent support in all modern browsers (Chrome 42+, Firefox 39+, Safari 10.1+, Edge 14+)
limitations: Cannot cancel requests easily without AbortController

webApis.name: Web Geolocation API
webApis.description: The Geolocation API allows web applications to access the user's geographical location information. It provides methods to retrieve the current position and watch for position changes, with user permission required for privacy protection.
usage: Social media check-ins and location sharing

components.name: navigator.geolocation
components.description: Main geolocation object providing location services

locationUtils.description: Utility functions for working with geolocation

webApis.browserSupport: Excellent support in all modern browsers and mobile devices
limitations: Accuracy varies greatly by device and environment
May not work in some indoor locations
Can be slow to acquire position
May be blocked by enterprise firewalls
